decisions.rationale: Bright and saturated for a projector, min pairwise CIE76 dE 42.5, text contrast >= 4.2:1.
decisions.alternatives: CSS named colours (navy/purple vanish on projectors); pastels.

decisions.decision: Keyboard harness on KeyboardEvent.code; F1-F6 plus number-row alternatives (7 8 9 0 - =); Start click requests fullscreen and navigator.keyboard.lock where available; ignore e.repeat; clear on blur; output the same PilotIn/GunnerIn/EngIn packets as phones via sim.applyInput(memberId).
decisions.rationale: Chrome delivers all commands except fullscreen/exit to the page only in fullscreen; alternatives guarantee the harness works everywhere.

decisions.decision: Bots: waypoint = weapon crate when unarmed else nearest enemy else any crate; steer by angle difference; stuck -> reverse; aim at 150 deg/s via dYaw; fire inside 55 m / 12 deg; a power every 8 s when sensible; shake when wet.
decisions.rationale: Fills four viewports with real combat without phones on day one.

decisions.decision: GameState is plain JSON data with absolute timers; it must not contain Rapier World/RigidBody/Collider objects or handles, Three objects, functions, Map/Set/Date, wall-clock times or derived fields.
decisions.rationale: Rapier handles are packed floats (observed 5e-324) that only mean something to the live World; the renderer, HUD and phones must read the state without the sim.
decisions.alternatives: Store handles on the boat records.

All of it was type-checked in a scratch copy with the repo's strict tsconfig (plus noUnusedLocals/Parameters, TS 5.9.3) and 57 vitest 5.0.5 tests pass; the repo was not modified. Key results: team balancing is teams = min(6, ceil(n/size)) with sizes floor/ceil spread (table for n = 1..18 for sizes 3 and 2), a rebalance that matches the balanced multiset to current team sizes so only surplus people move (most recent unpinned joiners first; at most one existing player moves per join, proven by test); manual swap/move pins players; capacity 6 x size with a join-order spectator queue; disconnects keep the slot and the keyboard takes it. Match flow is lobby -> countdown 10 -> battle 300 -> optional overtime 30 (tied teams only, others 'out', next kill wins, else first-to-score then draw) -> results 20 -> lobby, all on absolute sim-time timers so pause = not stepping. Hit resolution order: not alive, own team, not lethal (Water Cannon, unboosted/slow ram, both boosted), spawn protection (Shield kept), Shield, sunk; mines credit the dropping team forever; timeline hit -> sinking 2 s -> respawn at 5 s -> protection to 8 s, ended by any firing including the Water Cannon (config flag); kill-cam uses the killer's pose frozen at the hit; docks need 80 m from every enemy with farthest-dock fallback; water 25/s fill, 40/s bail at full shake, 20/s auto-drain for 1-2 person teams. Aim: assist bends up to 4 deg toward the smallest-offset enemy in an 8 deg / 70 m cone, 'under crosshair' is a ray-vs-3.5 m hull circle with 4.6 m hysteresis, the 0.6 gyro gain is applied by the sim when integrating the phone's raw dYaw, Torpedo locks the nearest enemy by distance in a 40 deg cone around the aim (not the bow), Mortar within 10 deg / 60 m else 40 m ahead, and line of sight (injected callback, Rapier castRay with ONLY_FIXED) gates the diamond, the assist and the lock but not the Mortar. Split-screen rects for 2..6 teams with minimap placement and a bottom-left GL conversion for three's setViewport/setScissor; team colours Rosso #E53935, Azzurro #29B6F6, Verde #4CAF50, Oro #FFD600, Viola #BA68C8, Arancio #FB8C00 with computed WCAG contrast and min pairwise dE 42.5. Keyboard harness on KeyboardEvent.code with F1-F6 plus number-row alternatives, fullscreen + Keyboard Lock to make F-keys reliable in Chrome, and a bot that drives, loots, fires and bails so four viewports can be tested without phones. GameState is plain JSON (round-trip verified) and must never hold Rapier handles (observed as 5e-324 packed floats).

decisions.decision: Team membership lives only in teams[i].members (ordered ids); role = index; players carry no team/role field (slotOf derives it).
decisions.rationale: One source of truth; duplicated fields drift after swaps and rebalances.

decisions.decision: teams = min(6, ceil(n/size)); sizes = floor(n/t) with the first n mod t teams +1; capacity 6 x size, extra joiners queue as spectators in join order.
decisions.rationale: Matches the spec's 7 -> 3+2+2 and 12 -> 4 teams; gives a closed-form table for n = 1..18.
decisions.alternatives: Fill teams to full size and leave a remainder (3+3+1).

decisions.decision: Rebalance matches the balanced multiset to teams by current size (ties: more pinned, lower index), dissolves the smallest teams, moves unpinned most-recent joiners first, fills deficits in join order, and runs after every join/leave/size change/manual move.
decisions.rationale: Each surplus person moves exactly once, which is the minimum for the target multiset; at most one existing player moves per join (tested).
decisions.alternatives: Re-deal everyone by join order after each change (re-seats many); leave imbalance until the host presses Balance.

decisions.decision: Manual swap pins both players; manual move needs a free slot (< teamSize), pins the mover, then the balancer may bump one unpinned player from an over-full team.
decisions.rationale: Keeps the spec's balance invariant while honouring deliberate placements.

decisions.decision: Disconnect during countdown/battle keeps the slot; the boat idles after 1.5 s without packets; reconnect by token resumes; keyboard focus (1-6) overrides; removal only in the lobby.
decisions.rationale: Nobody's role changes mid-match; the keyboard is the spec's backup.

decisions.decision: Start requires at least 2 teams each with a connected Pilot; missing Enable controls or Ready is only a warning.
decisions.rationale: The keyboard can cover any phone; one stuck person must not block the room.

decisions.decision: Overtime is its own GameState phase, mapped to 'battle' in the phone Hud; non-tied boats become status 'out' (removed, their mines/projectiles cleared); tied boats keep position and items, dead ones respawn immediately, all are minimap-revealed; still tied after 30 s -> earliest final kill wins, 0-0 -> draw.
decisions.rationale: Eliminated teams must not decide the match; 30 s is too short for hide and seek; one deterministic end.
decisions.alternatives: Repeat overtime; coin flip; keep eliminated boats as hazards.

decisions.decision: All timers are absolute sim times compared with simTime; pause = do not step; results auto-return to a rematch-ready lobby after 20 s.
decisions.rationale: No drift, pause freezes everything, tests are instant.

decisions.decision: Hit check order: not alive, own team, not lethal, spawn protection (Shield kept), Shield, sunk.
decisions.rationale: A fresh boat must not lose a looted Shield to a shot the bubble should absorb.

decisions.decision: Any firing ends spawn protection, Water Cannon included (config flag weapons.waterCannon.endsSpawnProtection).
decisions.rationale: The stream pushes enemies into mines and walls; the spec calls it a kill setup.

decisions.decision: Kill-cam follows the killer while alive and falls back to the killer's pose frozen at the hit; debug sinks show the own boat with 'SUNK'.
decisions.rationale: No cut to an empty dock when the killer sinks or respawns.
decisions.alternatives: Follow the killer entity regardless of status.

decisions.decision: Respawn dock: random among docks >= 80 m from every enemy and >= 12 m from any boat or earlier pick this step; fallback farthest-from-nearest-enemy; last resort any dock.
decisions.rationale: Spec's spawn-kill rule plus no double booking.

decisions.decision: Water: fill 25/s, bail shake x 40/s on 3-person teams (no natural drain), 20/s automatic on 1-2 person teams; speed x (1 - 0.5 w/100).
decisions.rationale: Spec's formula and 'half speed' rule; the Engineer keeps a job.

decisions.decision: Crate points have a fixed category (3 of 5 red); contents rolled by weight among enabled tiers (Cannon 50 / Torpedo 30 / Mortar 20; Shield 35 / Mine 35 / Boost 20 / Smoke 5 / Wave 5); respawn 8 s, 4 s in the last minute when stretch is on.
decisions.rationale: Gunners need weapons to score; tiers are one table.
decisions.alternatives: Random category per respawn; equal weights.

decisions.decision: Aim assist picks the smallest angular offset within 8 deg / 70 m and bends by at most 4 deg; 'under crosshair' is a ray-vs-hull-circle test (3.5 m, 4.6 m sticky) within 90 m; the 0.6 gain is applied by the sim when integrating the phone's raw dYaw.
decisions.rationale: Angular test matches what the player sees; hysteresis stops flicker; the phone cannot know about enemies and the sim is the single source of truth.
decisions.alternatives: Nearest-by-distance assist; fixed-angle crosshair test; apply the gain on the phone.

decisions.decision: Torpedo lock = nearest enemy by distance in a 40 deg cone around the AIM, within 70 m; Mortar = nearest within 10 deg / 60 m ignoring walls, else 40 m ahead along the aim.
decisions.rationale: The lock ring sits on the crosshair; a bow-relative lock could fire at an off-screen boat; homing makes distance matter more than angle.

decisions.decision: Line of sight (Rapier world.castRay with QueryFilterFlags.ONLY_FIXED, injected as a callback) gates the red diamond, the assist and the Torpedo lock; not the Mortar.
decisions.rationale: A diamond or lock on a boat behind a wall invites wasted shots; cost is at most 6 rays per step.
decisions.alternatives: No LOS; LOS for the Mortar too.

decisions.decision: Ranking: kills desc, deaths asc, earliest lastKillAt, index; results add topGunner (most kills by one player, any role) and bestRam (highest lethal ram impact speed).
decisions.rationale: Spec order plus a deterministic podium for places 2..6.

decisions.decision: Layouts: 2 = halves, 3 = 2x2 with BR overview, 4 = 2x2 with a centred square minimap (24% of height), 5 = 3x2 with BR overview, 6 = 3x2 with a 22% centre minimap; top bar overlay x 0.28..0.72, h 7.5%; rects normalised top-left with toGlPixels for three.

data.topic: Game rules, lobby and team logic, match flow, HUD data, keyboard harness and the tuning config (src/sim/rules.ts, teams.ts, items.ts, aim.ts, hud.ts; src/scene/layout.ts, keyboard.ts, bot.ts; shared/config.ts, shared/state.ts; tests)
data.summary: Wrote /private/tmp/claude-502/-Users-makhlugjafarov-cognitex-Documents-regata-storica/69884729-7585-4b5d-ad26-4af5e194adaa/scratchpad/research/rules/final.md: the spec's words on the problem, every decision with rejected alternatives, and 14 ready-to-paste files (shared/config.ts, shared/state.ts, src/sim/{teams,rules,items,aim,hud}.ts, src/scene/{layout,keyboard,bot}.ts, tests/{teams,rules,aim,layout}.test.ts). All of it was type-checked in a scratch copy with the repo's strict tsconfig (plus noUnusedLocals/Parameters, TS 5.9.3) and 57 vitest 5.0.5 tests pass; the repo was not modified. Key results: team balancing is teams = min(6, ceil(n/size)) with sizes floor/ceil spread (table for n = 1..18 for sizes 3 and 2), a rebalance that matches the balanced multiset to current team sizes so only surplus people move (most recent unpinned joiners first; at most one existing player moves per join, proven by test); manual swap/move pins players; capacity 6 x size with a join-order spectator queue; disconnects keep the slot and the keyboard takes it. Match flow is lobby -> countdown 10 -> battle 300 -> optional overtime 30 (tied teams only, others 'out', next kill wins, else first-to-score then draw) -> results 20 -> lobby, all on absolute sim-time timers so pause = not stepping. Hit resolution order: not alive, own team, not lethal (Water Cannon, unboosted/slow ram, both boosted), spawn protection (Shield kept), Shield, sunk; mines credit the dropping team forever; timeline hit -> sinking 2 s -> respawn at 5 s -> protection to 8 s, ended by any firing including the Water Cannon (config flag); kill-cam uses the killer's pose frozen at the hit; docks need 80 m from every enemy with farthest-dock fallback; water 25/s fill, 40/s bail at full shake, 20/s auto-drain for 1-2 person teams. Aim: assist bends up to 4 deg toward the smallest-offset enemy in an 8 deg / 70 m cone, 'under crosshair' is a ray-vs-3.5 m hull circle with 4.6 m hysteresis, the 0.6 gyro gain is applied by the sim when integrating the phone's raw dYaw, Torpedo locks the nearest enemy by distance in a 40 deg cone around the aim (not the bow), Mortar within 10 deg / 60 m else 40 m ahead, and line of sight (injected callback, Rapier castRay with ONLY_FIXED) gates the diamond, the assist and the lock but not the Mortar. Split-screen rects for 2..6 teams with minimap placement and a bottom-left GL conversion for three's setViewport/setScissor; team colours Rosso #E53935, Azzurro #29B6F6, Verde #4CAF50, Oro #FFD600, Viola #BA68C8, Arancio #FB8C00 with computed WCAG contrast and min pairwise dE 42.5. Keyboard harness on KeyboardEvent.code with F1-F6 plus number-row alternatives, fullscreen + Keyboard Lock to make F-keys reliable in Chrome, and a bot that drives, loots, fires and bails so four viewports can be tested without phones. GameState is plain JSON (round-trip verified) and must never hold Rapier handles (observed as 5e-324 packed floats).

decisions.decision: Team membership lives only in teams[i].members (ordered ids); role = index; players carry no team/role field (slotOf derives it).
decisions.rationale: One source of truth; duplicated fields drift after swaps and rebalances.

decisions.decision: teams = min(6, ceil(n/size)); sizes = floor(n/t) with the first n mod t teams +1; capacity 6 x size, extra joiners queue as spectators in join order.
decisions.rationale: Matches the spec's 7 -> 3+2+2 and 12 -> 4 teams; gives a closed-form table for n = 1..18.
decisions.alternatives: Fill teams to full size and leave a remainder (3+3+1).

decisions.decision: Rebalance matches the balanced multiset to teams by current size (ties: more pinned, lower index), dissolves the smallest teams, moves unpinned most-recent joiners first, fills deficits in join order, and runs after every join/leave/size change/manual move.
decisions.rationale: Each surplus person moves exactly once, which is the minimum for the target multiset; at most one existing player moves per join (tested).
decisions.alternatives: Re-deal everyone by join order after each change (re-seats many); leave imbalance until the host presses Balance.

decisions.decision: Manual swap pins both players; manual move needs a free slot (< teamSize), pins the mover, then the balancer may bump one unpinned player from an over-full team.
decisions.rationale: Keeps the spec's balance invariant while honouring deliberate placements.

decisions.decision: Disconnect during countdown/battle keeps the slot; the boat idles after 1.5 s without packets; reconnect by token resumes; keyboard focus (1-6) overrides; removal only in the lobby.
decisions.rationale: Nobody's role changes mid-match; the keyboard is the spec's backup.

decisions.decision: Start requires at least 2 teams each with a connected Pilot; missing Enable controls or Ready is only a warning.
decisions.rationale: The keyboard can cover any phone; one stuck person must not block the room.

decisions.decision: Overtime is its own GameState phase, mapped to 'battle' in the phone Hud; non-tied boats become status 'out' (removed, their mines/projectiles cleared); tied boats keep position and items, dead ones respawn immediately, all are minimap-revealed; still tied after 30 s -> earliest final kill wins, 0-0 -> draw.
decisions.rationale: Eliminated teams must not decide the match; 30 s is too short for hide and seek; one deterministic end.
decisions.alternatives: Repeat overtime; coin flip; keep eliminated boats as hazards.

decisions.decision: All timers are absolute sim times compared with simTime; pause = do not step; results auto-return to a rematch-ready lobby after 20 s.
decisions.rationale: No drift, pause freezes everything, tests are instant.

decisions.decision: Hit check order: not alive, own team, not lethal, spawn protection (Shield kept), Shield, sunk.
decisions.rationale: A fresh boat must not lose a looted Shield to a shot the bubble should absorb.

decisions.decision: Any firing ends spawn protection, Water Cannon included (config flag weapons.waterCannon.endsSpawnProtection).
decisions.rationale: The stream pushes enemies into mines and walls; the spec calls it a kill setup.

decisions.decision: Kill-cam follows the killer while alive and falls back to the killer's pose frozen at the hit; debug sinks show the own boat with 'SUNK'.
decisions.rationale: No cut to an empty dock when the killer sinks or respawns.
decisions.alternatives: Follow the killer entity regardless of status.

decisions.decision: Respawn dock: random among docks >= 80 m from every enemy and >= 12 m from any boat or earlier pick this step; fallback farthest-from-nearest-enemy; last resort any dock.
decisions.rationale: Spec's spawn-kill rule plus no double booking.

decisions.decision: Water: fill 25/s, bail shake x 40/s on 3-person teams (no natural drain), 20/s automatic on 1-2 person teams; speed x (1 - 0.5 w/100).
decisions.rationale: Spec's formula and 'half speed' rule; the Engineer keeps a job.

decisions.decision: Crate points have a fixed category (3 of 5 red); contents rolled by weight among enabled tiers (Cannon 50 / Torpedo 30 / Mortar 20; Shield 35 / Mine 35 / Boost 20 / Smoke 5 / Wave 5); respawn 8 s, 4 s in the last minute when stretch is on.
decisions.rationale: Gunners need weapons to score; tiers are one table.
decisions.alternatives: Random category per respawn; equal weights.

decisions.decision: Aim assist picks the smallest angular offset within 8 deg / 70 m and bends by at most 4 deg; 'under crosshair' is a ray-vs-hull-circle test (3.5 m, 4.6 m sticky) within 90 m; the 0.6 gain is applied by the sim when integrating the phone's raw dYaw.
decisions.rationale: Angular test matches what the player sees; hysteresis stops flicker; the phone cannot know about enemies and the sim is the single source of truth.
decisions.alternatives: Nearest-by-distance assist; fixed-angle crosshair test; apply the gain on the phone.

decisions.decision: Torpedo lock = nearest enemy by distance in a 40 deg cone around the AIM, within 70 m; Mortar = nearest within 10 deg / 60 m ignoring walls, else 40 m ahead along the aim.
decisions.rationale: The lock ring sits on the crosshair; a bow-relative lock could fire at an off-screen boat; homing makes distance matter more than angle.

decisions.decision: Line of sight (Rapier world.castRay with QueryFilterFlags.ONLY_FIXED, injected as a callback) gates the red diamond, the assist and the Torpedo lock; not the Mortar.
decisions.rationale: A diamond or lock on a boat behind a wall invites wasted shots; cost is at most 6 rays per step.
decisions.alternatives: No LOS; LOS for the Mortar too.

decisions.decision: Ranking: kills desc, deaths asc, earliest lastKillAt, index; results add topGunner (most kills by one player, any role) and bestRam (highest lethal ram impact speed).
decisions.rationale: Spec order plus a deterministic podium for places 2..6.

decisions.decision: Layouts: 2 = halves, 3 = 2x2 with BR overview, 4 = 2x2 with a centred square minimap (24% of height), 5 = 3x2 with BR overview, 6 = 3x2 with a 22% centre minimap; top bar overlay x 0.28..0.72, h 7.5%; rects normalised top-left with toGlPixels for three.
decisions.rationale: Spec table; three's setViewport/setScissor use a bottom-left origin.

decisions.decision: Team colours Rosso #E53935 (white text), Azzurro #29B6F6, Verde #4CAF50, Oro #FFD600, Viola #BA68C8, Arancio #FB8C00 (black text), with a black halo on borders/crosshairs.
decisions.rationale: Bright and saturated for a projector, min pairwise CIE76 dE 42.5, text contrast >= 4.2:1.
decisions.alternatives: CSS named colours (navy/purple vanish on projectors); pastels.

decisions.decision: Keyboard harness on KeyboardEvent.code; F1-F6 plus number-row alternatives (7 8 9 0 - =); Start click requests fullscreen and navigator.keyboard.lock where available; ignore e.repeat; clear on blur; output the same PilotIn/GunnerIn/EngIn packets as phones via sim.applyInput(memberId).
decisions.rationale: Chrome delivers all commands except fullscreen/exit to the page only in fullscreen; alternatives guarantee the harness works everywhere.

decisions.decision: Bots: waypoint = weapon crate when unarmed else nearest enemy else any crate; steer by angle difference; stuck -> reverse; aim at 150 deg/s via dYaw; fire inside 55 m / 12 deg; a power every 8 s when sensible; shake when wet.
decisions.rationale: Fills four viewports with real combat without phones on day one.

decisions.decision: GameState is plain JSON data with absolute timers; it must not contain Rapier World/RigidBody/Collider objects or handles, Three objects, functions, Map/Set/Date, wall-clock times or derived fields.
decisions.rationale: Rapier handles are packed floats (observed 5e-324) that only mean something to the live World; the renderer, HUD and phones must read the state without the sim.
decisions.alternatives: Store handles on the boat records.
